summarize_dataset_info: summarize the crowdpose2goliath dataset_info config that maps CrowdPose keypoints to the Goliath schema
review_dataset_config: review the crowdpose2goliath dataset config to verify keypoint and skeleton mappings from Goliath
build_dataset_variant: build a new dataset variant by copying goliath dataset_info and renaming the dataset_name field
test_dataset_config: test the crowdpose2goliath config by importing dataset_info and checking the dataset_name equals crowdpose2goliath
refactor_dataset_mapping: refactor the crowdpose2goliath dataset config to add custom keypoint or skeleton overrides
